meta.purpose: PS section 8, Risk 3: pre-fill is demonstrated against a simulated HTML form only. The UI must label it 'Prototype - not for live sites'.
meta.notice: Prototype - not for live sites. Simulated form. No data leaves this machine.

behaviour.description: Clicking a field shows an editable AI suggestion. Nothing is written into the form until the user clicks Fill. PS section 8, Risk 1 requires a human in the loop.
behaviour.abstention: A field whose confidence is below the abstention threshold is marked `abstained` and shows a warning instead of a value.
